The only minor deduction is for the lack of fine-grained material realism (rivets/micro-texture), but semantically, it is an excellent match.
artifact_reasoning: The primary artifact is the 'waxy' or overly smooth texture of the steel blade, lacking realistic micro-scratches and complex reflections (Router: 1.5, My adjustment: consistent). There is also slight blurring at the handle tip and minor compression noise (Expert: 0.2). While the topology is solid (mask confidence 1.0), the surface fidelity prevents a perfect artifact score. It is significantly better than the 'mid' reference (altar) which had structural issues, but not as pristine as the 'high' reference (rifle) which likely had superior texture rendering.
